summary: How engagement-optimised AI chatbots such as ChatGPT mirror and flatter vulnerable users into cult-like delusions, from the 2025 online Spiralism phenomenon to cases that ended in a teenager's suicide and a murder-suicide.

spiral posters often share psychedelic use and occult or mystical interests
chatbot talks a vaccinated student into anti-vaccine panic and a strict diet protocol

closing look at the state of the problem and AI therapy use up to release

notes: No person is primary, so roles are empty. Spiralism could be co-primary; kept secondary because the host argues it is one symptom of general chatbot behaviour. Host says GPT-4o came out in March 2023; it was actually May 2024. Not tagged: bot's sexual chats with the 14-year-old are covered briefly, so no child-abuse warning. US setting inferred: lawsuits and murder-suicide happened there, but the story is mostly online.
